label: Cafeteria - Magpie Incident
description: Magpie's fixation on a guard's shiny watch turns meal hour volatile.
text:
The cafeteria buzzed with tray clatter, tired insults, and the stale reek of institutional food that looked barely a step above paste. Guards watched from the walls like they were waiting for the room to justify their hands. The murals flaking above the tables tried to look therapeutic, but under the fluorescent flicker everything in Arkham still came down to pressure, hunger, and who could embarrass whom in public.

Harley Quinn and Poison Ivy had already claimed space at one of the tables, turning an untouched meal and a few dirty jokes into the beginning of trouble. Across the room, Selina Kyle looked like she was deciding whether the whole ward was beneath her or merely predictable. And then Magpie saw it.

A guard's gold watch flashed once under the light. That was enough. Margaret Pye's breath caught in a tiny delighted sound as she drifted toward it with the helpless devotion of someone who had stopped seeing the man wearing it and started seeing only the shine.

The room shifted before anyone touched anything. In Arkham, everybody knew a stupid little impulse could become a public beating in less than ten seconds.
